LanguageData.FH_Quest_FleshSurvivor_Description:
A blood-soaked researcher is approaching the colony. She contacted you from nearby, claiming that she has just escaped from a research facility disaster that spiraled out of control. Her memory of the event is already badly fragmented, and a pack of frenzied fleshbeasts is hunting her. She asks for protection in your colony and promises to join afterward.

If you accept her request, the fleshbeasts will arrive within one hour.

For unknown reasons, the researcher is suffering from severe amnesia. You cannot obtain any further information.
